evidence_basis: Read both final decision files in full, then rehashed them before recording this review.

findings.finding: APR priority follows the user-directed independent ordinal review and the next consequential uncertainty. Sunk effort and historical allocation are explicitly excluded as EV proxies. Conditional rank is not represented as computed return per dollar; no invented probability, NPV or allocation appears.

New gains are specific source reconciliation, nominal article clarification, two model leads, current company filing and an explicit claim amendment. No exhaustive fresh portfolio revaluation is claimed; lack of a new alternative-favoring fact is not presented as universal superiority.

USD25000-100000 and 2-5 months are attributed analyst assumptions, with quotes, actual spending and verified delivery time excluded. Patient trials, major model construction, licensing, GLP, GMP clinical manufacture and commercialization are outside the envelope.

The decision preserves the original two-child denominator, zero additional verified people/cohorts, site additions and unresolved P2 annotation conflict. It rejects crossing a P2 baseline score with a P1 follow-up score and does not infer a causal response magnitude.

Nominal formula consistency is separated from clinical-lot identity, stability transfer, delivered dose per area and tissue/systemic exposure. Existing-article qualification is plausible, not free, validated or necessarily accessible.

Salois access and expression limits are retained. Di Girolamo is correctly updated to public institutional full text; I537T mechanical repetitions are distinguished from donors and from broader genotype responsiveness. Different-intervention cell cohesion is not represented as APR rescue or mature-barrier reversal.

Ongoing clinically useful control is distinguished from full barrier restoration and off-treatment regeneration. Tissue integrity, benefit and acceptable exposure remain required for the intended claim, without compulsory perfect cornification, mechanism, withdrawal persistence or new preclinical reset.

Major chemistry, vehicle, model or rights burden triggers renewed marginal comparison rather than automatic extension. A separately evaluated clinical route, narrower claim, evidence/public-benefit route and cash/wait remain possible. Company inactivity is not equated with abandoned rights.

All six restrictions are explicitly false in activity and no execution is authorized. Public-source pass is closed; reopening requires a substantive source/access/product/transaction fact. Previously closed searches remain closed; no automation is created.
Decision, rank basis, model limits, claim override, budget assumptions, route boundaries, zero new clinical/experimental units and all restrictions are consistent between the reviewed files.

resolved_issues.resolution: Final decision explicitly supersedes the universal gate for the intended ongoing-control claim while preserving stronger-claim requirements and historical-file integrity.
